prompt:
Screen-accurate interface design of a desktop web application. NOT a poster, NOT a photograph, NOT a device mockup, NOT a browser window. A flat, straight-on UI screenshot filling the whole canvas. Light theme. English text, left-to-right.

Product: AKR-TMS, an anti-money-laundering and KYC monitoring system for Iraqi banks. Screen: "Command centre", the dashboard of the bank's money laundering reporting officer (MLRO).

LAYOUT, left to right:
1. A narrow left navigation rail, about 72 px wide, solid #0F2147 (deep lapis navy), full height. At the top a small logo: a rounded square containing three gold (#C8A24B) cuneiform wedge shapes arranged to form a tick mark. Below it, nine simple thin line icons in pale grey-blue, each with a tiny label underneath: Command centre (active: brighter, with a 3 px gold #C8A24B bar on its left edge), Alerts, Cases, Customers, Screening, Scenarios, Reports, Data, Governance.
2. The main area, background #F5F0E6 (warm clay off-white).

MAIN AREA, top to bottom:
A. Top bar, about 56 px tall: page title "Command centre" in 22 px semibold #18202F; beside it a muted line in #5B6474: "Demo Bank · data as of 06 Oct 2026, 14:32". On the right: a search field with placeholder "Search customers, accounts, cases", a bell icon, and a circular avatar with initials "MA" and a small label "MLRO".
B. A row of five equal KPI cards (white #FFFFFF, 1 px border #DDD6C9, 8 px corner radius, no shadow). Each card: a small uppercase label in #5B6474, a large value (28 px semibold #18202F), and a one-line caption:
   - DATA COVERAGE — "100%" — caption "All 14 CBS tables reconciled today" with a small green #2F7D4F check icon.
   - LIST FRESHNESS — "38 min" — caption "UN · Iraq national list · OFAC · EU · UK".
   - OPEN ALERTS — "1,284" — caption "212 older than 30 days" in amber #B26A00.
   - STRS FILED, 30 DAYS — "27" — caption "goAML · 2 awaiting MLRO sign-off".
   - OVERDUE KYC REVIEWS — "96" — caption "High risk: 11" in red #B3261E.
C. A middle row with two white panels (same card style):
   - Left panel, about 60 percent width, titled "Alert backlog by age": a horizontal stacked bar chart, one bar per queue (Cash, Transfers, Trade finance, Screening, Staff accounts), segments for age buckets "0-7 days", "8-30", "31-60", "60+" in #1E4FA0, #1F8A8A, #F2A33A, #B3261E, with a small legend underneath and count labels.
   - Right panel, about 40 percent width, titled "Regulatory deadlines": a list of five rows, each with a short label on the left and a small rounded date chip on the right: "CTR batch to AML/CFT Office — Today 23:59" (red chip), "Correspondent RFI (USD clearing) — 2 days" (amber chip), "CBI monthly account movements report — 10 Oct" (blue chip), "Periodic review: 11 high-risk customers — Overdue" (red chip), "Annual screening system test — 18 days" (grey chip).
D. A bottom row with three white panels:
   - "Customer risk distribution": a donut chart with three segments High 6% (#B3261E), Medium 21% (#F2A33A), Low 73% (#2F7D4F), with labels and counts.
   - "Top scenarios this month": a compact table with columns Scenario, Alerts, Productive. Rows: "Cash split across branches | 312 | 18%", "Rapid in-and-out transfers | 201 | 12%", "Dormant account reactivated | 88 | 9%", "Trade invoice mismatch | 41 | 22%".
   - "Correspondent evidence pack": a status card with the line "Last generated 01 Oct 2026", a checklist of four items each with a green #2F7D4F tick: "Screening test results", "Scenario coverage matrix", "Tuning log approved", "Backlog and timeliness", and a solid button "Generate pack" in #1E4FA0 with white text.

TYPOGRAPHY: a clean humanist sans-serif like IBM Plex Sans throughout; tabular figures for numbers; panel titles 15 px semibold #18202F; small labels 11-12 px uppercase with slight letter spacing in #5B6474. All text crisp, legible and correctly spelled English.

COLOURS: use only #0F2147, #1E4FA0, #1F8A8A, #C8A24B (logo and active marker only), #F5F0E6, #FFFFFF, #18202F, #5B6474, #DDD6C9, #B3261E, #B26A00, #F2A33A, #2F7D4F.

MUST NOT APPEAR: gradients, glows, drop shadows, glassmorphism, 3D effects, perspective tilt, photos, people, emojis, decorative illustrations, lorem ipsum, browser chrome, laptop or monitor frames, watermarks.
